svg.title: Lantern Vale — next village building prototypes
svg.desc: Woodcutter, woodworking workshop, farm and town hall concepts, with four existing town hall visual upgrade variants. Same isometric vector style as the approved production buildings. Proposed artwork only; current footprints and gameplay are unchanged.

g.text: LANTERN VALE / NEXT BUILDINGS / FIRST PROTOTYPES
Muted roofs, framed timber, quiet stonework and visible tools. Current building footprints retained.
Olive timber shelter · round logs · splitting block
A compact woodland workplace, with a clear chopping area.
Sage roof · open bench · hand tools and finished wood
Woodworking identity: boards, vise, hand plane and a bowl.
Harvest ochre roof · crop hatch · seed sacks and rake
A small farmstead; planted acres stay separate.
Blue slate roof · civic banner · broad stone steps
A welcoming civic building, with five existing visual stages.
DESIGN REVIEW ONLY · presentation pads are illustrative · no gameplay or footprint changes implemented
